messages:
alex: Hey team — promo question. Moving an IC to Senior IC with a ~12% comp uplift and a cross-border move (US -> UK). Payroll cutoff is Tuesday; can we get retro and comp change in this cycle?

maria: Hi @alex — possible but tight. Must submit the promotions intake form + manager justification + new comp fields + desired effective date + manager sign-off + market note before cutoff. Link: https://redwood.internal/hr/promotions-intake

sam: UK specifics: set tax_jurisdiction=UK on the HRIS ticket, include P45 if available, and add NI number once obtained. We normally don't gross-up. If >10% change, cc finance for explicit approval.

payroll-bot: payroll reminder: payroll bundle closes in ~40 hours (1787730000). Items after cutoff process next cycle.

maria: If you want retro this run, include a compact evidence block in the intake (paste these bullets):

```
- 2 bullets: measurable impact / stretch
- New responsibilities mapped to band rubric
- Market comp snapshot (1-pg)
- Manager approval: alex@redwood.com
```

alex: If effective date is mid-month in UK, will taxes be handled automatically? Any retro tax surprises?

sam: Payroll prorates gross and uses cumulative tax coding in the UK. Retro pay will be taxed in the period it's paid; payroll will calculate tax/NI. For statutory holiday accruals, comp changes aren't usually applied retroactively. If you need special handling, mark ticket with "escalate-to-comp".

alex: How long for equity grant approval? Need it before offer notice.

sam: Stock-admin SLA is ~10 business days after a fully completed grant request + approvals. If you need faster, include business justification and cc stock-admin in the intake.

maria: Steps for you: 1) open intake form + paste evidence block, 2) set tax_jurisdiction: UK and attach any paperwork, 3) choose effective date & retro preference, 4) cc finance if >10% change. Ill triage immediately.

alex: Filing now. Will ping if cutoff is tight. :thumbsup:
